Option 1 — one line (recommended)

Paste at the end of the site's footer. The badge renders in its own Shadow DOM, so the site's CSS cannot break it.

Motion: at rest only the Λ mark sways gently — “CRAFTED BY” stays still. Hover (or keyboard focus) types the family like the site intro — <UzLeeder> → <LeeCodes> → <Max's Code> — and moving away returns it to the normal wordmark. With “reduce motion” there is no waving and the words swap without typing. Try it on the previews above.

Option 2 — plain HTML (no script)

  
For sites that do not allow external scripts. Uses the site's own fonts if Outfit is not loaded. This version is static — the waving and the typing need Option 1.
